questions.answer: If I were you, I would try hard to make friends.
questions.question:

<보기>
if / I / my / it / will / paint / have / room / pink / to / had / would / were

questions.answer: If I were diligent and he gave me a piece of advice on time, I could finish my homework.

나는 제 시간에 숙제를 끝낼 수 있을 텐데. (diligent, a piece, on time)

A: *만약 네가 영화감독이라면 너는 뭘 할 거야?*
B: I would make a documentary movie.

Q: Anna sits on a mattress, but the mattress isn't firm enough. If you were Anna, what would you do?
A: *내가 그녀라면, 누군가가 그 매트리스를 교체하도록 할 텐데.* (get, the, someone, replace)

questions.answer: If I left without saying good-bye

('good-bye'를 사용하고, 6단어로 쓸 것)

questions.answer: I were an archeologist, I would study many ancient tombs in Egypt.

내가 만약 당신이라면, 그에게 사실을 말할 텐데.

나에게 강아지가 있다면, 슬프지 않을 텐데.

<조건>
1. 가정법 과거의 형식을 이용할 것
2. <보기>의 단어 중 필요한 것만 사용할 것
3. 우리말 문장의 의미에 맞게 문장을 완성할 것

<보기>
I, you, my, your, she, her, to, clothes, am, I, were, will, would, let, get, wear, worn, have, had

내가 너라면, 그녀가 너의 옷을 입도록 해줄 텐데.
→ If (A) __________ (B) __________
acceptedAnswers: (A) I were you, (B) I would have her wear your clothes.

questions.answer: I were you, I would turn off the lights.
questions.question:
다음 대화의 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.

A: What's the matter, Jenny?
B: I want to save energy. What should I do?
A: 내가 너라면, 불필요한 불을 끌 거야. 
B: That's a good idea.

<조건>
1. lights를 포함할 것
2. 가정법 과거를 사용할 것

→ If __________ __________ __________, __________
acceptedAnswers: I were you, I would turn off unnecessary lights.

A: I think James is the luckiest boy in the world. He is smart, good-looking, and even kind.
B: It isn't luck. It's the effort he puts into everything he does.
A: What do you mean? He seems to do everything so effortlessly.
B: (if / know / truth / surprise). He sleeps less than 4 hours a day.

<조건>
1. 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 이용하되, 중복 사용이 가능하고 필요한 경우 형태를 변화시킬 것.
2. 현재 의미를 나타내는 가정법으로 작문할 것
3. '반납하다'는 네 번째 철자가 'u'인 단어로 쓸 것.
4. '이해심 있는'은 'g'로 끝나는 단어로 쓸 것이며, 철자 중 'c'는 쓰지 말 것

questions.answer: If I were not sick, I would go to the party today.

A: Why not?
B: I don't know her number. If I knew her number, I would call her today.

A: Are you going to the party today?
B: I really want to, but I can't.
A: Why not?
B: I'm very sick. ___________________.

Juno notices that Yuna copies his homework several times without asking him. He doesn't want Yuna to do it again. He wants to get some advice from one of her friends, Mira.
 
                                                                                          ↓

Juno: Yuna seems to copy my homework several times. I don't want her to do it again. She should not do it. What __________ __________  __________ __________ __________ __________ in my situation?
Mira: If I were you, I would honestly tell her what I think.

This summer vacation is going to be the best vacation ever. I'm going to Cancun, Mexico! My uncle lives there, and my family is going to visit him. I'm so excited __________ (have / wings / if / fly)
